In force-voltage analogy:  
- Force (F) is analogous to voltage (V)  
- Velocity (v) is analogous to current (i)  
- Mechanical spring: \( F = K \int v \, dt \)  
- Electrical analog: \( V = \frac{1}{C} \int i \, dt \)  
Thus, spring constant \( K \) corresponds to \( 1/C \).  

Final answer: (C)
